semantically_equivalent_domains.justification: '3d processing' is a broad term that encompasses any processing tasks related to 3D data, including geometry processing.
'3d data processing' involves handling and manipulating 3D data, which inherently includes geometry processing as part of its tasks.

parent_domains.justification: '3d processing' is a broad term covering any processing related to 3D data, including geometry processing.
'3d data processing' involves all types of processing tasks related to 3D data, making it a broad category under which 3D geometry processing falls.
3d modeling involves creating a representation of an object in a 3D space, which requires understanding geometry.
'3d shape analysis' involves examining the geometric properties of 3D objects, making it a parent domain to geometry processing.

closest_parent_domain.justification: '3d processing' is the closest parent domain as it directly refers to any type of processing applied to 3D data, including geometry processing.

child_domains.justification: 3d mesh processing is a specific task within geometry processing, dealing with polygonal meshes.
Mesh processing is a task focusing on manipulating mesh data structures, which is a subset of geometry processing tasks.
3d shape modeling involves creating and manipulating specific 3D shapes, which can be seen as a part of geometry processing.

closest_child_domain.justification: 3d mesh processing specifically focuses on operations related to 3D meshes, which is a major component of 3D geometry.

sibling_domains.justification: While 3D Modeling broadly covers designing 3D objects, it shares an emphasis on geometry similar to geometry processing.
3d shape analysis focuses on understanding geometric properties and hence is closely related to geometry processing.
This domain focuses on how 3D objects are represented in a system, which is closely tied to understanding their geometries.

closest_sibling_domain.justification: 3d shape analysis deals with understanding the geometric properties of a shape, which is very close to the goals of 3d geometry processing.

unrelated_domains.justification: This involves understanding higher level semantics from scenes rather than focusing on geometry.
3d animation deals with creating motion and transformation over time, which is separate from static geometry processing tasks.
While '3d generation' could involve aspects of geometry, it generally refers to creation tasks rather than processing existing geometry data.
This involves altering the shape of 3D models, which is a specific type of operation that does not directly encompass geometry processing.
3d vision is more about interpreting and understanding 3D data from a visual perspective, which is a different context than geometry processing.
